mapper.select: SELECT b.id, t.user_id, t.user_name, t.avatar, t.sex, t.age, b.update_time, b.taking_id, t.on_line as onLine FROM user_browse b LEFT JOIN tb_user t ON b.by_browse_id = t.user_id left join order_taking o on b.taking_id=o.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} and t.user_id is not null and o.id is not null order by b.update_time desc
